Regions use screen ratios; for example, the lower half is 0,0.5,1,0.5. Exclude black borders. Phira reads chart aspectRatio automatically; turn off automatic viewport if the game uses a different ratio. The pause icon defaults to the upper-left region; upper-right can use 0.82,0,0.18,0.24. Phira retry delay defaults to its 700 ms opening animation; chart offsets are applied automatically. Visual capture compensation is limited to 0–120 ms and touch offset to -80–80 ms.
Region values must be from 0 to 1 and remain inside the screen
